name: What is the R-value, and why is it important for wall insulation?
description: R-value measures insulation's resistance to heat flow; a higher number means better insulation. It's crucial for energy efficiency and comfort.

mainEntity.name: What is the R-value, and why is it important for wall insulation?

acceptedAnswer.text: R-value is a measure of thermal resistance, indicating how well an insulation material resists heat flow. A higher R-value means greater insulating power. For wall insulation, a higher R-value helps keep your home warmer in winter and cooler in summer, leading to improved energy efficiency and comfort. The recommended R-value for walls can vary based on your climate zone and local building codes. Your contractor will consider these factors to recommend the appropriate R-value for your specific project.
